queue.title: Tray
queue.description: Everything waiting on an admin, together in one place. Whatever has been waiting longest comes first.
queue.claimHelpHint: Taking an item says you are on it and drops it out of everybody else's tray. It is released on its own after {{minutes}} minutes.
queue.claimSuccess: You took it: it is yours while you resolve it
queue.releaseSuccess: You released it: it goes back to the tray
queue.emptyTitle: Nothing is waiting for an action
queue.emptyDescription: An empty tray is good news: no request is left unanswered and no table is left unreviewed.
queue.approveConfirmDescription: The table will open so players can apply to it.
queue.requestChangesDialogDescription: Tell the master what to fix before you approve it.

errors.ITEM_ALREADY_CLAIMED: Another admin took it first and is resolving it. While they hold it, nobody else can work on this.
errors.generic: We could not complete the action. Try again.

requests.title: Requests
requests.description: Everything somebody asks an admin for: the master role, a table to be opened, or anything else. It opens showing what is still waiting for an answer.
requests.searchPlaceholder: Text of the reason, or the name of whoever asked
requests.emptyPendingTitle: Nothing is waiting for an answer
requests.emptyPendingDescription: When somebody asks for something it will show up here. Remove the “Pending” filter to see what has already been resolved.
requests.noResultsDescription: Try other words, or narrow by kind with /request_type and by status with /status.
requests.approveDialogDescription: Read the reason and write your answer. It is recorded and it reaches whoever asked.
requests.rejectDialogDescription: Write why. It is the only thing whoever asked will receive, so it has to be enough for them to understand.

effect.MasterGrant: On approval the person is given the master role by the same road as in “Users”, recorded with your note as the reason.
effect.TableOpen: On approval it is recorded that the request stands. The table is not created on its own: the request carries no name, system, seats or schedule, so you create it from “Tables”.
effect.General: On approval the request is closed and your answer reaches whoever asked. Nothing else on the platform changes.
effect.TablePause: On approval the table is paused: it stops promising dates and its pending sessions are hidden until it is resumed. Your note becomes the reason in its history.
effect.PlayerBan: This one is not yours to resolve: a ban is decided by the table’s master, from its Players tab.

requests.approveNotePlaceholder: Why you are approving it. It reaches whoever asked.
requests.rejectNotePlaceholder: Why you are turning it down. It reaches whoever asked.
requests.resolveHelpHint: Approving does not do the same thing for every kind of request.
requests.detailDialogDescription: What they asked for, and how it was resolved.
requests.detailStillPending: It has not been resolved yet.

errors.REQUEST_ALREADY_PENDING: You already have a request of this kind waiting for an answer. That one has to be resolved before you make another.
errors.REQUEST_ALREADY_RESOLVED: Somebody has already resolved this request. Refresh the screen to see how it went.
errors.REQUEST_ENTITY_GONE: What this request pointed at no longer exists, so it cannot be resolved.
errors.MASTER_ROLE_ALREADY_HELD: You already have the master role.
errors.generic: We could not complete the action. Try again.
errors.NOT_PRIMARY_MASTER: The table’s master resolves this, not an admin. A ban request is answered from the table itself.

submit.flowReviewed: An admin will read it and answer with a reason of their own.

MasterGrant.title: Ask for the master role
MasterGrant.description: Tell an admin why you want to run tables.
MasterGrant.effect: If it is approved, you will be able to create tables and run them.
MasterGrant.placeholder: What you want to run, what experience you have, whatever you think helps.

TableOpen.title: Ask for a table to be opened
TableOpen.description: Tell an admin what table you would like to exist.
TableOpen.effect: If it is approved, an admin finds a master and creates the table. It is not created on its own.
TableOpen.placeholder: Which system, which day, for how many people. The more concrete, the better.

General.title: Ask an admin something
General.description: For whatever the help does not answer.
General.effect: If it is approved, they answer you and the request is closed. Nothing else changes.
General.placeholder: What you need. Say enough for somebody to be able to answer.

ask.TableOpen: Ask for a table to be opened

pending.MasterGrant: You already asked for the master role and have not been answered yet.
pending.TableOpen: You already asked for a table to be opened and have not been answered yet.
pending.General: You already wrote to an admin and have not been answered yet.

requests.submitHelpHint: The reason is required, and so is the answer you get back.
requests.masterGrantPitchTitle: Do you want to run tables?
requests.masterGrantPitchDescription: The master role is given by an admin. Ask for it, saying what you would like to run.
requests.generalPitchTitle: Did you not find your answer?
requests.generalPitchDescription: Write to an admin. They answer right here, with a notification.
requests.supportDescription: This is where you ask for help when what you read was not enough.
requests.supportWhereHelpLives: The explanations live on each screen, in the help link next to whatever you are doing.

users.title: Users
users.description: Every account on the platform, blocked ones included. Roles are moved and accounts are closed from here.
users.emptyDescription: Accounts show up here as soon as somebody signs in for the first time.
users.noResultsDescription: Try another name, or search by role with /role and by status with /status.
users.justificationPlaceholder: Why you are making this change. It is recorded.
users.roleDialogDescription: Pick a role to give it or take it away. Every change is recorded with its reason.
users.roleWillRevoke: The {{role}} role will be taken away from {{name}}.
users.blockDialogDescription: Read what this means before you confirm.
users.blockConsequenceAccess: They will not be able to sign in to the platform again.
users.blockConsequenceData: Their data is kept: their tables, their applications and their history stay as they are.
users.unblockDialogDescription: They will be able to sign in again. The reason is recorded.
users.historyDialogDescription: Every role change and every block, with who made it and why.
users.historyEmptyDescription: Nobody has changed this account's roles or status yet.

errors.ROLE_GRANT_FORBIDDEN: Only an Owner can give or take away the Admin and Owner roles.
errors.CANNOT_BLOCK_PRIVILEGED: An account holding Admin or Owner cannot be blocked.
errors.LAST_OWNER: The platform cannot be left without an Owner. Give the role to somebody else before taking this one away.
errors.CANNOT_REVOKE_OWN_OWNER: You cannot take away your own Owner role. Another Owner has to do it.
errors.generic: We could not apply the change. Try again.

users.roleHelpHint: An admin moves Player and Master; Admin and Owner are moved by an owner only.
users.blockHelpHint: An account holding Admin or Owner cannot be blocked, and neither can your own.

tables.title: Tables
tables.description: Every table on the platform, with its status. Whatever is waiting on a review is resolved from the tray.
tables.emptyDescription: Tables show up here as soon as a master creates one, or as soon as you create one without a master.
tables.noResultsDescription: Try another name, or narrow by status with /table_status and by master with /table_master.
tables.assignMastersDialogDescription: The table opens as soon as it gets a master.
tables.noMastersSelected: You have not picked anybody yet.
tables.mastersOrderHint: The first one you add is the master and the rest are co-masters. Tap a name to make them the master.
tables.createUnassignedDialogTitle: Create a table without a master
tables.createUnassignedDialogDescription: It stays unassigned until you give it a master.
tables.deleteConfirmDescription: It was never published, so it is removed without a trace. This cannot be undone.
tables.pauseDialogDescription: Say why it is being paused. The table’s master reads this, and it stays in its status history.
tables.pauseHint: While it is paused the table promises no dates: its pending sessions are hidden.
tables.resumeConfirmDescription: The pending sessions are rescheduled from today, keeping their numbering. The players’ dates change.

errors.SCHEDULE_CONFLICT: It cannot be resumed: the agenda clashes with “{{otherTableName}}”, which this table’s master is already committed to.
errors.generic: We could not complete the action. Try again.

settings.title: Settings
settings.description: The values the community adjusts without a deploy. Each one shows what is in use, what it ships as, and the range it can move inside.

profiles.visibility_window_days.label: Profile visibility window
profiles.visibility_window_days.description: How long after a table finishes or is cancelled its members can still see each other's profile. While the table is paused the clock does not run.
profiles.visibility_window_days.retroactiveWarning: Careful: this change does not wait. Lowering it takes visibility away from people who have it right now, and raising it hands it back to people who had already lost it.

files.max_file_size_mb.label: Per-file size cap
files.max_file_size_mb.description: The most a file uploaded to the platform may weigh. Files already uploaded are left alone.

tables.max_players_cap.label: Maximum table capacity
tables.max_players_cap.description: The highest player cap a master may give a table. It does not shrink tables that already exist: it applies the next time somebody creates or edits one.

admin_queue.claim_timeout_minutes.label: Tray reservation timeout
admin_queue.claim_timeout_minutes.description: How long an admin keeps an item of the shared tray reserved before it becomes available to everybody else again.

settings.neverChanged: Never changed: still on the shipped default.
settings.justificationPlaceholder: Why this value is being changed
settings.justificationHint: Required: a settings change sends no notification and shows up nowhere, so the reason is the whole record it leaves behind.
settings.emptyDescription: The platform published no adjustable values. If that is not what you expected, tell whoever maintains the system.
settings.historyDialogDescription: Every change, with who made it and why.
settings.historyEmptyDescription: Nobody has touched this value yet: it is still on the shipped default.
settings.historyFirstChange: Set to {{to}}, over the shipped default

errors.SETTING_OUT_OF_RANGE: That value is outside what this setting allows: it has to be between {{minValue}} and {{maxValue}}.
errors.generic: We could not save the change. Try again.
